requirementRecords.title: Multi-Modal System Compiler & Bounded DAG Plan Synthesis
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Compile all 6 input types through 12 stages into an acyclic DAG with 100% 4-way traceability.

testResult.measuredSummary: 5/5 compiler test cases passed; 6 input types lowered across 12 stages; 100% 4-way traceability.

knownLimitations: Requires explicit numeric threshold on subjective performance statements when failOnBlockingAmbiguity is enabled.

requirementRecords.title: Zero-Trust Default-Deny OPA Policy-as-Code Gate
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Enforce default-deny Rego policy across Tiers 0..3 and require single-use time-bounded human ApprovalRecord on Tier 2/3.

verificationMethod.oracleRule: unloadedBundle === DENY && expiredToken === DENY && selfApproval === DENY

testResult.measuredSummary: 4/4 policy security suites passed; 100% block rate on unloaded bundle, expired approval, and scope mismatch.

knownLimitations: Local evaluation uses deterministic TypeScript Rego bundle evaluator synchronized with governance.rego.

requirementRecords.title: Durable Workflow State Machine with Disk WAL & Crash Recovery
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Persist workflow transitions to hash-chained .wal.jsonl and .checkpoint.json, survive process restart, and execute LIFO rollback.

testResult.measuredSummary: 5/5 workflow suites passed; crash resume verified across independent engine instances; LIFO rollback & fence tokens verified.

knownLimitations: Maximum nested sub-workflow depth capped at 2 levels per governance specification.

requirementRecords.title: Non-Bypassable Controlled Tool Gateway & Sandboxed Execution Runtime
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Separate planning from execution, validate all tool I/O schemas, block direct adapter bypass, and auto-rollback failed mutations.

testResult.measuredSummary: 3/3 runtime suites passed across all 11 engineering tools; HMAC gateway seal & live Windows x64 csc.exe worker DPAPI/NTFS junction gates verified.

knownLimitations: Tier 2 dependency.manage and deploy.prepare require explicit single-use Reviewer/ReleaseManager ApprovalGrant.

requirementRecords.title: Six-Layer Epistemic Knowledge Engine & Generated-Artifact Quarantine
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Separate 6 epistemic layers, support Obsidian Markdown vault sync, detect conflicts, and prevent unverified generated content from polluting authoritative docs.

testResult.measuredSummary: 3/3 knowledge & memory suites passed; Obsidian YAML frontmatter/[[Wikilink]] round-trip and generated-artifact quarantine verified.

knownLimitations: Promotion of GENERATED_ARTIFACT to VERIFIED_FACT requires an AGT-19 EXECUTION_EVIDENCE PASS record.

requirementRecords.title: Deterministic 64-Bit Float DSP Engine & ITU-R BS.1770-4 Loudness Analyzer
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Render composable DSP chains bit-identically, suppress inter-sample true peaks below ceiling, and round-trip Float32 RIFF WAV losslessly.

testResult.measuredSummary: Bit-identical phase-cancellation null test (-144 dBFS residual); True-Peak limiter enforced <= -1.0 dBTP; Float32 WAV round-trip verified.

knownLimitations: Native Rust cargo binary build for workers/audio-engine/src/lib.rs requires optional host rustc/cargo installation.

requirementRecords.title: Steinberg VST3 Processor/Controller Split & Real-Time Audio Safety
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Isolate Plane 3 real-time audio callback from Plane 2 controller/AI copilot with zero heap allocations, zero locks, and lossless preset persistence.

testResult.measuredSummary: 0 forbidden allocation/lock tokens in C++20 core; passed block-size (1..4096) & sample-rate (44.1..96 kHz) host torture suite.

knownLimitations: Compiling a binary .vst3 DLL on host requires external C++20 compiler (cl.exe/clang++), C:\JUCE, C:\VST_SDK, and pluginval.exe.

requirementRecords.title: Multi-DAW Replaceable Adapter Framework & FL Studio 2025 Qualification
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Support replaceable DAW adapters (FL Studio 2025 + REAPER), inspect FLhd/FLdt .flp files read-only, and refuse undocumented binary mutations.

testResult.measuredSummary: Verified live FL Studio 2025 (25.1.6.4997) NewStuff.flp (45 ch, 96 PPQ) & Breakbeat.flp (11 ch, 48 PPQ) with 0 bytes mutated; Python 3.14 controller script verified.

knownLimitations: Direct in-place .flp binary mutation and FLEngine_x64.dll memory injection are intentionally blocked per ADR-0009.

requirementRecords.title: Emergency Stop Preemption, OPA Latency & Dual-Control Release Integrity
requirementRecords.expectedBehavior: Preempt workflows in < 100 ms on emergency stop, evaluate OPA in < 15 ms P99, and enforce Reviewer != ReleaseManager dual-control promotion.

testResult.measuredSummary: Emergency stop preemption < 5 ms; OPA evaluation P99 < 2 ms; 5/5 canary soak & CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM + SLSA v1.0 provenance verified.

knownLimitations: Production cloud secret manager (GCP Secret Manager / Vault) is abstracted via ServerSideSecretManager in local/staging runs.
